Update, 5:36 p.m. ET: Apple has also released the fifth public betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a) and tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a).

Developers can now install the fifth betas of several upcoming software updates, including iPadOS 26.6. Read on for the details.

Fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and HomePod 26.6 now available

As the beta cycle for Apple’s 26.6 software updates winds down, the company is releasing the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a), watchOS 26.6 (23U5062b), tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a), visionOS 26.6 (23O5765a), and HomePod 26.6 (23L5766a).

These updates are arriving alongside the fifth betas of iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, also focused on bug fixes, some of which Apple pushed out early because of increasing AI-related security threats.

This is likely the final round of betas before release candidates (RCs) are released. With the formal release of 26.6 on the horizon, attention is shifting to iOS 27 and its related updates, expected to launch publicly this fall. Apple is also expected to release the first public betas soon.

Either way, developers can now install the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 and its counterparts, with public versions expected in the coming days.
